verses.sloka: पुत्र शोक अर्दितम् पापा विसम्ज्ञम् पतितम् भुवि ।विवेष्टमानम् उदीक्ष्य सा ऐक्ष्वाकम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-१॥
verses.transliteration: putra śoka arditam pāpā visamjñam patitam bhuvi ।viveṣṭamānam udīkṣya sā aikṣvākam idam abravīt ॥2-14-1॥

translations.english: The evil woman (Kaikeyi) said to the king of the Ikshvaku race who lay unconscious on the floor writhing and tormented with grief on account of his son.
translations.hindi: व, अयोध्याकाशड का सोलहवाँ सग समास हुआ | —१०:— सप्तदशः सग; — Neb स रामो रथमास्थाय सम्परहृएसुहुज्जनः । पताकाध्वजसम्पन्नं महाहांगरुधू पितम्‌

verses.sloka: पापम् क्Rत्वा इव किम् इदम् मम सम्श्रुत्य सम्श्रवम् ।शेषे क्षिति तले सन्नः स्थित्याम् स्थातुम् त्वम् अर्हसि ॥२-१४-२॥
verses.transliteration: pāpam kRtvā iva kim idam mama samśrutya samśravam ।śeṣe kṣiti tale sannaḥ sthityām sthātum tvam arhasi ॥2-14-2॥

translations.english: (Kaikeyi said) What is this? After hearing my response to the promised boon, why are you lying down on the floor dejected as if you had committed a sin? It behoves you to maintain your status.

verses.sloka: आहुः सत्यम् हि परमम् धर्मम् धर्मविदो जनाः ।सत्यम् आश्रित्य हि मया त्वम् च धर्मम् प्रचोदितः ॥२-१४-३॥
verses.transliteration: āhuḥ satyam hi paramam dharmam dharmavido janāḥ ।satyam āśritya hi mayā tvam ca dharmam pracoditaḥ ॥2-14-3॥

translations.english: Those conversant with righteousness say that truth is a great virtue. By following the truth, I have enlightened you about your duty.
translations.hindi: अगर की धूप से सुबासित राजमार्ग पर हो कर] श्री राम चन्द्र जी जा रहे थे । सड़कों के किनारे चन्दन और अगर की लकड़ी के ढेर लगे हुए थे

verses.sloka: सम्श्रुत्य शैब्यः श्येनाय स्वाम् तनुम् जगती पतिः ।प्रदाय पक्षिणो राजन् जगाम गतिम् उत्तमाम् ॥२-१४-४॥
verses.transliteration: samśrutya śaibyaḥ śyenāya svām tanum jagatī patiḥ ।pradāya pakṣiṇo rājan jagāma gatim uttamām ॥2-14-4॥

translations.english: O King O lord of the earth (king) Saibya attained the highest state by offering his own body to a hawk in accordance with his promise.

verses.sloka: तथ हि अलर्कः तेजस्वी ब्राह्मणे वेद पारगे ।याचमाने स्वके नेत्रेउद्ध्Rत्य अविमना ददौ ॥२-१४-५॥
verses.transliteration: tatha hi alarkaḥ tejasvī brāhmaṇe veda pārage ।yācamāne svake netreuddhRtya avimanā dadau ॥2-14-5॥

translations.english: In the same way the lustrous king Alarka, on being solicited by a brahmin who was an adept in the Vedas, plucked his own eyes and gave them to him without hesitation.
translations.hindi: वे उत्तम राजमार्ग अबाधित ( सब वस्तुएँ ह खुली हुई रखी थीं, चोरों का डर न था ) सुशोभित हो रहे थे । दूकान ज i के सोदागरी के सामानों से तथा खाने-पीने की चीजों 4: थीं

verses.sloka: सरिताम् तु पतिः स्वल्पाम् मर्यादाम् सत्यम् अन्वितः ।सत्य अनुरोधात् समये वेलाम् खाम् न अतिवर्तते ॥२-१४-६॥
verses.transliteration: saritām tu patiḥ svalpām maryādām satyam anvitaḥ ।satya anurodhāt samaye velām khām na ativartate ॥2-14-6॥

translations.english: The ocean, lord of rivers, even when (tidal) time comes does not cross the shore in obedience to truth.
translations.hindi: $ से.अरी हुई १ श्रसम्बाधः --चौरादिबाधारहितम्‌। ( शि०) २ संबृतं--ब्याप्त । ( वि० ) 2 ८ ग्र => ददश तं राजपथं दिवि देवपथं यथा । दध्यक्षतहविलाजेधृ पेरगरुचन्दने!

verses.sloka: स्त्यमेकपदं ब्रह्मे सत्ये धर्मः प्रतिष्ठतः।सत्यमेवाक्षया वेदाः सत्येनै वाप्यते परम् ॥२-१४-७॥
verses.transliteration: styamekapadaṁ brahme satye dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhataḥ।satyamevākṣayā vedāḥ satyenai vāpyate param ॥2-14-7॥

translations.english: Truth is Brahman in one word. Righteousness is firmly established in truth. Truth is the imperishable Vedas. The supreme state can be attained by means of truth.
translations.hindi: अनेक प्रकार के पुष्पों और अनेक सुगन्धित द्रव्यो से चोराहे सुशोभित थे । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी सुहृदों के दिए हुए आशीवोद को सुनते जाते थे

verses.sloka: सत्यं समनुवर्त्स्व यदि धर्मे धृता मतिः ।सफलः स वरो मेऽस्तु वरदो ह्यसि सत्तम ॥२-१४-८॥
verses.transliteration: satyaṁ samanuvartsva yadi dharme dhṛtā matiḥ ।saphalaḥ sa varo me'stu varado hyasi sattama ॥2-14-8॥

translations.english: O excellent one, if your mind is firmly fixed in righteousness, then by following it fulfil the boon granted to me.You are the bestower of boons indeed
translations.hindi: और यथोचित उन सब लोगों का आदर करते जाते थे । अनेक बूढ़े लोग कहते थे कि जिस प्रकार तुम्हारे बाबा (पितामह) ओर दादा (प्रपितामह) ने राज्य किया

verses.sloka: धर्मस्येहाभिकामार्थं मम चैवाचिचोदनात् ।प्रव्राजय सुतं रामम् त्रिः खलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥२-१४-९॥
verses.transliteration: dharmasyehābhikāmārthaṁ mama caivācicodanāt ।pravrājaya sutaṁ rāmam triḥ khalu tvāṁ bravīmyaham ॥2-14-9॥

translations.english: You must uphold righteousness. I also urge you to do that. Send your son Rama to the forest. I am repeating this statememt thrice.

verses.sloka: समयम् च मम आर्य इमम् यदि त्वम् न करिष्यसि ।अग्रतः ते परित्यक्ता परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम् ॥२-१४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: samayam ca mama ārya imam yadi tvam na kariṣyasi ।agrataḥ te parityaktā parityakṣyāmi jīvitam ॥2-14-10॥

translations.english: O noble one, if you do not fulfil the agreement, it will mean I have been abandoned by you. (Therefore) I will give up my life in your presence.

verses.sloka: एवम् प्रचोदितः राजा कैकेय्या निर्विशन्कया ।न अशकत् पाशम् उन्मोक्तुम् बलिर् इन्द्र क्Rतम् यथा ॥२-१४-११॥
verses.transliteration: evam pracoditaḥ rājā kaikeyyā nirviśankayā ।na aśakat pāśam unmoktum balir indra kRtam yathā ॥2-14-11॥

translations.english: In this way urged by Kaikeyi without fear or hesitation, he (Dasaratha), like Bali unable to release himself from the noose cast by Indra (through Vamana), could not get out of the noose of promise.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि राज्याभिषिक्त हो कर श्रीरामच निकलने पर ओर उनको देखने पर उससे बढ़कर प्रिय और सुखदायक है

verses.sloka: उद्भ्रान्त ह्Rदयः च अपि विवर्ण वनदो अभवत् ।स धुर्यो वै परिस्पन्दन् युग चक्र अन्तरम् यथा॥२-१४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: udbhrānta hRdayaḥ ca api vivarṇa vanado abhavat ।sa dhuryo vai parispandan yuga cakra antaram yathā॥2-14-12॥

translations.english: Like a bullock, restlessly moving between the wheels and the yoke, Dasaratha's heart started beating wildly and his face turned pale.

verses.sloka: विह्वलाभ्याम् च नेत्राभ्याम् अपश्यन्न् इव भूमिपः ।क्Rच्च्रात् धैर्येण सम्स्तभ्य कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: vihvalābhyām ca netrābhyām apaśyann iva bhūmipaḥ ।kRccrāt dhairyeṇa samstabhya kaikeyīm idam abravīt ॥2-14-13॥

translations.english: The king was unable to see with his eyes overwhelmed (with tears). Gaining with great difficulty a firm footing and courage he addressed Kaikeyi:

verses.sloka: यः ते मन्त्र क्Rतः पाणिर् अग्नौ पापे मया ध्Rतः ।तम् त्यजामि स्वजम् चैव तव पुत्रम् सह त्वया ॥२-१४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ te mantra kRtaḥ pāṇir agnau pāpe mayā dhRtaḥ ।tam tyajāmi svajam caiva tava putram saha tvayā ॥2-14-14॥

translations.english: O wicked woman, I held your hand amid chantings of mantras with the sacred fire (as witness). I now disown that hand, you and your son begotten by me.
translations.hindi: अमित तेजस्वी श्रीरामचन्द्र के राज्याभि हि ज्याभिषेक से बढ़क लिए और कोई वस्तु प्रिय नहीं है। इस प्रकार अपने धो ह के अन्य जनों के मुख से अपनी प्रशंसा सुन, उदासीन पात से दति जी ५ जाते थे । श्रीराम चन्द्र जी की ओर से न' को ॒ दी का मन हो अघाता था और न उनकी ओ os । ` आँख ही हटती थी ॥१२-१३॥ ह ७... | :१ भुक्तन--ऐहिक विप्रय भोगज सुखेन। ( रा०) ट्र जी के इस मार्ग से जो आनन्द हमको प्राप्त होगा हमारे लिए और कुछ भी नहीं शी ~ र हे FE " ET RES 7 क ४ MN OTS: She. ~ RT TRS NR Iannis नरः शक्नोत्यपाक्रष्ट्मतिक्रान्तेऽपि राधवे । यश्च रामं न पश्येत्त॒ यं च रामो न पश्यति

verses.sloka: प्रयाता रजनी देवि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति ।अभिषेकं गुरुजन्स्त्वरयीष्यति मां ध्रुवम् ॥२-१४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: prayātā rajanī devi sūryasyodayanaṁ prati ।abhiṣekaṁ gurujanstvarayīṣyati māṁ dhruvam ॥2-14-15॥

translations.english: O queen the night has departed and the Sun is about to rise. The preceptors now will definitely ask me to hasten for the consecration.

verses.sloka: रामाभिषेकसम्भारैस्तदर्थमुपकल्पितैः ।रामः कारयितव्यो मे मृतस्य सलिलक्रियाम् ॥२-१४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: rāmābhiṣekasambhāraistadarthamupakalpitaiḥ ।rāmaḥ kārayitavyo me mṛtasya salilakriyām ॥2-14-16॥

translations.english: With the materials already collected for the consecration of Rama he will perform my funeral rite of offering water to the dead.
translations.hindi: इसीसे चारों वणं के लोग अपनी उम्र के अनुसार उनमें अनुराग रखते थे अथवा उनके अनुयायी थे । राजकुमार श्रीराम- चन्द्र चोराहों, देवालयों, चैत्यबृत्तों, सभामणडपों

verses.sloka: त्वया सपुत्त्रया नैव कर्तव्या सलिलक्रिया ।व्याहन्तास्यशुभाचारे यदि रामाभिषेचन्म् ॥२-१४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā saputtrayā naiva kartavyā salilakriyā ।vyāhantāsyaśubhācāre yadi rāmābhiṣecanm ॥2-14-17॥

translations.english: O woman of inauspicious practices, since you are obstructing Rama's coronation, you and your son shall not perform my funeral rite of offering water to the dead.
translations.hindi: के पास से इस प्रकार जाते जिससे उनकी प्रदक्षिणा होः 'जातीथी । ( चलते-चलते ) श्रीरामचन्द्र जी राजभवन में पहुँचे । बह राजभवन मेघसमूह के समान जान पड़ता था

verses.sloka: न च शक्नोम्यहं द्रषुं पूर्वं तथा सुखम् ।हतहर्षं निरानन्दं पुनर्जनमवाङ्मुखम् ॥२-१४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: na ca śaknomyahaṁ draṣuṁ pūrvaṁ tathā sukham ।hataharṣaṁ nirānandaṁ punarjanamavāṅmukham ॥2-14-18॥

translations.english: Having seen people formerly enjoying happiness, I cannot see them again with their downcast, cheerless faces devoid of all happiness.
translations.hindi: ओर उस राजभवन के विविध शिखर, केलास पर्वत के शिखर जैसे जान पड़ते थे । भवन की अनेक सफेद अटारियाँ गगन-मण्डल को उसी प्रकार छाए हुए थीं जिस प्रकार सफेद “रंग के विमान आकाश को छा लेते हैं

verses.sloka: तां तथा ब्रुवत्स्तस्य भूमिपन्य महात्मनः ।प्रभाता शर्वरी पुण्या चन्द्रनक्षत्रश्रालिनी ॥२-१४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ tathā bruvatstasya bhūmipanya mahātmanaḥ ।prabhātā śarvarī puṇyā candranakṣatraśrālinī ॥2-14-19॥

translations.english: While the king was thus speaking to her (Kaikeyi) that holy night resplendent with the Moon and the stars, the day dawned.

verses.sloka: ततः पाप समाचारा कैकेयी पार्थिवम् पुनः ।उवाच परुषम् वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञा रोष मूर्चिता ॥२-१४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pāpa samācārā kaikeyī pārthivam punaḥ ।uvāca paruṣam vākyam vākyajñā roṣa mūrcitā ॥2-14-20॥

translations.english: Thereafter, Kaikeyi of sinful conduct and skilful in the use of words, rendered senseless by wrath, again addressing the king in harsh words said:
translations.hindi: राजपुत्रः पितुर्वेश्म प्रविवेश श्रिया ज्वलन | स कक्ष्या धन्विभिशुप्तास्तिस्रोऽतिक्रम्य वाजिभि; २०॥। 'जकुमार श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अपने पिता के ऐसी शोभा से युक्त राजभवन में पहुँचे । वे तीन ड्योढ़ियों पर, जहाँ तीर- न्दाज सिपाहियों के पहरे लगे हुए थे, रथ पर बैठे हुए ही चले गए

verses.sloka: किम् इदम् भाषसे राजन् वाक्यम् गर रुज उपमम् ।आनाययितुम् अक्लिष्टम् पुत्रम् रामम् इह अर्हसि ॥२-१४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: kim idam bhāṣase rājan vākyam gara ruja upamam ।ānāyayitum akliṣṭam putram rāmam iha arhasi ॥2-14-21॥

translations.english: O king, why are you speaking these painful, poisonous words? What is this? It behoves you to summon your son Rama who does not expearience this pain.

verses.sloka: स्थाप्य राज्ये मम सुतम् क्Rत्वा रामम् वने चरम् ।निह्सपत्नाम् च माम् क्Rत्वा क्Rत क्Rत्यो भविष्यसि ॥२-१४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: sthāpya rājye mama sutam kRtvā rāmam vane caram ।nihsapatnām ca mām kRtvā kRta kRtyo bhaviṣyasi ॥2-14-22॥

translations.english: Only after you have installed my son in the kingdom and sent Rama to the forest and made me free from rivals, you shall have your duty fulfiled.

verses.sloka: स नुन्नैव तीक्षेन प्रतोदेन हय उत्तमः ।राजा प्रदोचितः अभीक्ष्णम् कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: sa nunnaiva tīkṣena pratodena haya uttamaḥ ।rājā pradocitaḥ abhīkṣṇam kaikeyīm idam abravīt ॥2-14-23॥

translations.english: The king who was very much incited by her words, like a horse of the best breed whipped by the lash, replied to Kaikeyi:

verses.sloka: धर्म बन्धेन बद्धो अस्मि नष्टा च मम चेतना ।ज्येष्ठम् पुत्रम् प्रियम् रामम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि धार्मिकम् ॥२-१४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: dharma bandhena baddho asmi naṣṭā ca mama cetanā ।jyeṣṭham putram priyam rāmam draṣṭum iccāmi dhārmikam ॥2-14-24॥

translations.english: I am bound by bond of righteousness. My intellect is destroyed. I wish to see my beloved, virtuous firstborn, Rama.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रभातां र्जनीमुदिते च दिवाकरे ।पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे चे मुहूर्ते च समाहिते ॥२-१४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhātāṁ rjanīmudite ca divākare ।puṇye nakṣatrayoge ce muhūrte ca samāhite ॥2-14-25॥

translations.english: The night dawned. Ths Sun rose. The auspicious time with the sacred star in (favourable) conjunction arrived. The virtuous Vasistha, surrounded by his disciples, soon entered the best of abodes with the articles collected (for the ceremony).

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठो गुणसंपन्नः शिष्येः परिवृतस्तदा ।उपगृह्याशु संभारान् [रविवेश पुरोत्तमम् ॥२-१४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho guṇasaṁpannaḥ śiṣyeḥ parivṛtastadā ।upagṛhyāśu saṁbhārān [raviveśa purottamam ॥2-14-26॥

translations.english: The night dawned. Ths Sun rose. The auspicious time with the sacred star in (favourable) conjunction arrived. The virtuous Vasistha, surrounded by his disciples, soon entered the best of abodes with the articles collected (for the ceremony).

verses.sloka: सिक्तसंमार्जितपथां पताकोत्तमभूषिताम् ।विचित्रकुसुमाकीर्णां नानास्रग्भिर्विराजिताम् ॥२-१४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: siktasaṁmārjitapathāṁ patākottamabhūṣitām ।vicitrakusumākīrṇāṁ nānāsragbhirvirājitām ॥2-14-27॥

translations.english: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious people rejoicing at the event. The stalls and markets were abundantly filled with merchandise.The city was full of great festivities. The people were curious to see Rama. Sandalwood and incense were burnt and fragrance pervaded in all the directions. The city resembled Amaravati, the abode of Indra. Vasistha entered the city, covered some distance and beheld the best inner apartment. There he saw host of brahmins, citizens and villagers. The best of inner apartments was graced with brahmins who were experts in sacrificial rituals priests and eminent brahmins.

verses.sloka: संहृष्टमनुजोपेतां समृद्धविपणापणाम् ।महोत्सवसमाकीर्णां राघवार्थे समुस्त्सुकाम् ॥२-१४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: saṁhṛṣṭamanujopetāṁ samṛddhavipaṇāpaṇām ।mahotsavasamākīrṇāṁ rāghavārthe samustsukām ॥2-14-28॥

translations.english: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious people rejoicing at the event. The stalls and markets were abundantly filled with merchandise.The city was full of great festivities. The people were curious to see Rama. Sandalwood and incense were burnt and fragrance pervaded in all the directions. The city resembled Amaravati, the abode of Indra. Vasistha entered the city, covered some distance and beheld the best inner apartment. There he saw host of brahmins, citizens and villagers. The best of inner apartments was graced with brahmins who were experts in sacrificial rituals priests and eminent brahmins.

verses.sloka: चन्दनागुरुधूपैश्च सर्वतः प्रतिधूपिताम् ।तां पुरीम् समतिक्रम्य पुरन्दरपुरोपमाम् ॥२-१४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: candanāgurudhūpaiśca sarvataḥ pratidhūpitām ।tāṁ purīm samatikramya purandarapuropamām ॥2-14-29॥

translations.english: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious people rejoicing at the event. The stalls and markets were abundantly filled with merchandise.The city was full of great festivities. The people were curious to see Rama. Sandalwood and incense were burnt and fragrance pervaded in all the directions. The city resembled Amaravati, the abode of Indra. Vasistha entered the city, covered some distance and beheld the best inner apartment. There he saw host of brahmins, citizens and villagers. The best of inner apartments was graced with brahmins who were experts in sacrificial rituals priests and eminent brahmins.

verses.sloka: ददर्शान्तः पुरश्रेष्ठं नानाद्विजगणायुतम् ।पौरजानपदाकिर्र्र्णं ब्राह्मणैरुपशोभितम् ॥२-१४-३०॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśāntaḥ puraśreṣṭhaṁ nānādvijagaṇāyutam ।paurajānapadākirrrṇaṁ brāhmaṇairupaśobhitam ॥2-14-30॥

translations.english: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious people rejoicing at the event. The stalls and markets were abundantly filled with merchandise.The city was full of great festivities. The people were curious to see Rama. Sandalwood and incense were burnt and fragrance pervaded in all the directions. The city resembled Amaravati, the abode of Indra. Vasistha entered the city, covered some distance and beheld the best inner apartment. There he saw host of brahmins, citizens and villagers. The best of inner apartments was graced with brahmins who were experts in sacrificial rituals priests and eminent brahmins.

verses.sloka: तदन्तः पुरमासाद्य व्यतिचक्राम तम् जनम् ॥२-१४-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tadantaḥ puramāsādya vyaticakrāma tam janam ॥2-14-31॥

translations.english: Having reached the inner apartment, the eminent ascetic, Vasistha felt very happy. He passed by the people and entered the inner apartment.

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठः परमप्रीतः परमर्षिर्विवेश च ।स त्वपश्यद्विनिष्क्रान्तं सुमन्त्रं नाम सारथिम् ।द्वारे मनुजसिंहस्य सचिवं प्रियदर्शन्म् ॥२-१४-३२॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaḥ paramaprītaḥ paramarṣirviveśa ca ।sa tvapaśyadviniṣkrāntaṁ sumantraṁ nāma sārathim ।dvāre manujasiṁhasya sacivaṁ priyadarśanm ॥2-14-32॥

translations.english: Sage Vasistha saw handsome Sumantra, minister to Dasaratha, a lion among the charioteers coming out of the gate.

verses.sloka: तमुवाच महातेजाः सूतपुत्रं विशारदम् ॥२-१४-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejāḥ sūtaputraṁ viśāradam ॥2-14-33॥

translations.english: Effulgent Vasistha said to the expert chariotieer Sumantra to inform the king immediately of his arrival.

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठः क्षिप्रमाचक्ष्व नृपते र्मामिहागतम् ।इमे गङ्गोदकघटाः सागरेभ्यश्च काञ्चनाः ॥२-१४-३४॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaḥ kṣipramācakṣva nṛpate rmāmihāgatam ।ime gaṅgodakaghaṭāḥ sāgarebhyaśca kāñcanāḥ ॥2-14-34॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: औदुम्बरं भद्रपीठमभिषेकार्थमागतम् ।सर्वबीजानि गन्धाश्च रत्नानि विविधानि च ॥२-१४-३५॥
verses.transliteration: audumbaraṁ bhadrapīṭhamabhiṣekārthamāgatam ।sarvabījāni gandhāśca ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥2-14-35॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: क्षौद्रम् दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः ।अष्टौ च कन्या रुचिरा मत्तश्छ वरवारणः ॥२-१४-३६॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaudram dadhi ghṛtaṁ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ ।aṣṭau ca kanyā rucirā mattaścha varavāraṇaḥ ॥2-14-36॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: चतुरश्वो रथः श्रीमान् निस्त्रिंशो धनुरुत्तमम् ।वाहनं नरसंयुक्तं चत्रं च शशिपन्निभम् ॥२-१४-३७॥
verses.transliteration: caturaśvo rathaḥ śrīmān nistriṁśo dhanuruttamam ।vāhanaṁ narasaṁyuktaṁ catraṁ ca śaśipannibham ॥2-14-37॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: श्वेते च वालव्यजने भृङ्गारुश्छ हिरण्मयः ।हेमदामपिनद्धश्च किकुद्मान् पाण्डुरो वृषः ॥२-१४-३८॥
verses.transliteration: śvete ca vālavyajane bhṛṅgāruścha hiraṇmayaḥ ।hemadāmapinaddhaśca kikudmān pāṇḍuro vṛṣaḥ ॥2-14-38॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: केसरी च चतुर्दंष्ट्रो हि श्रेष्ठो महाबलः ।सिंहानस्नं व्याघ्रतनुः समिद्धश्छ हुताशनः ॥२-१४-३९॥
verses.transliteration: kesarī ca caturdaṁṣṭro hi śreṣṭho mahābalaḥ ।siṁhānasnaṁ vyāghratanuḥ samiddhaścha hutāśanaḥ ॥2-14-39॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: सर्ववादित्रसंघाश्च वेश्याश्छालंकृताः स्त्रियः ।आचार्या ब्राह्मणा गावः पुण्यश्च मृगपक्षिणः ॥२-१४-४०॥
verses.transliteration: sarvavāditrasaṁghāśca veśyāśchālaṁkṛtāḥ striyaḥ ।ācāryā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ puṇyaśca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ॥2-14-40॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: पौरजानपदश्रेष्ठा नैगमाश्च गणैः सह ।एते चान्ये च बहवो नीयमानाः प्रियम्वदाः ॥२-१४-४१॥
verses.transliteration: paurajānapadaśreṣṭhā naigamāśca gaṇaiḥ saha ।ete cānye ca bahavo nīyamānāḥ priyamvadāḥ ॥2-14-41॥

translations.english: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious stones, honey, curd, ghee, puffed grains, kusha grass (special grass used in rituals), flowers, milk, eight beautiful girls, an intoxicated elephant, a dignified chariot drawn by four horses, a sword, an elegant bow, a palanquin accompanied by bearers, an umbrella resembling the full Moon, two white fans made of Yak's tails, a golden vessel, a palecoloured humped bull, wearing golden gerland, a lion having four strong and large teeth, a mighty horse of the best breed, a throne, tiger skin, fire kindled with faggots, all kinds of musical instruments, courtesans, welldecorated women, preceptors, brahmins, cows, sacred animals and birds, eminent citizens and villagers, groups of merchants all speaking pleasant words and kings -- all are here for Rama's coronation.

verses.sloka: अभिषेकाय रामस्य सह तिष्ठन्ति पार्थिवैः ।त्वरयस्व महाराजं यथा समुदितेऽहनि ॥२-१४-४२॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣekāya rāmasya saha tiṣṭhanti pārthivaiḥ ।tvarayasva mahārājaṁ yathā samudite'hani ॥2-14-42॥

translations.english: Hasten the maharaja as Rama has to be installed in the kingdom as soon as the day breaks under the conjunction of the sacred Pushya star.

verses.sloka: पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात् ।इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रो महात्मनः ॥२-१४-४३॥
verses.transliteration: puṇye nakṣatrayoge ca rāmo rājyamavāpnuyāt ।iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sūtaputro mahātmanaḥ ॥2-14-43॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the great Vasistha, charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment, singing the praise of this tiger among kings (Dasaratha).

verses.sloka: स्तुवन्नृपतिशार्धूलं प्रविवेश निवेशनम् ।तं तु पूर्वोदितं वृद्धं द्वारस्था राजसम्मतम् ॥२-१४-४४॥
verses.transliteration: stuvannṛpatiśārdhūlaṁ praviveśa niveśanam ।taṁ tu pūrvoditaṁ vṛddhaṁ dvārasthā rājasammatam ॥2-14-44॥

translations.english: The doorkeepers, beloved wellwishers of the king, did not detain aged Sumantra who was liked by the king and who had arrived early.

verses.sloka: न शेकुरभिसंरोद्धुं राज्ञः प्रयचिकीर्ष्वः ।स सवीपस्थितो राज्ञ्स्तामवस्थामजज्ञीवान् ॥२-१४-४५॥
verses.transliteration: na śekurabhisaṁroddhuṁ rājñaḥ prayacikīrṣvaḥ ।sa savīpasthito rājñstāmavasthāmajajñīvān ॥2-14-45॥

translations.english: Sumantra approached the king unaware of the state of his mind and commenced praising him in highly pleasing words (as usual).

verses.sloka: वाग्भिः परमतुष्टाभिरभिष्टोतुं प्रचक्रमे ।ततः सूतो यथाकालं पार्थिवस्य निवेशने ॥२-१४-४६॥
verses.transliteration: vāgbhiḥ paramatuṣṭābhirabhiṣṭotuṁ pracakrame ।tataḥ sūto yathākālaṁ pārthivasya niveśane ॥2-14-46॥

translations.english: Thereafter the charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment of the king, and with folded hands began singing the praise of the lord of the earth appropriate to the hour.

verses.sloka: सुमन्त्रः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तुष्टाव जगतीपतिम् ।यथा नन्दति तेजस्वी सागरो भास्करोदये ।प्रीतह् प्रीतेन मनसा तथानन्दघनः स्वतः ॥२-१४-४७॥
verses.transliteration: sumantraḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā tuṣṭāva jagatīpatim ।yathā nandati tejasvī sāgaro bhāskarodaye ।prītah prītena manasā tathānandaghanaḥ svataḥ ॥2-14-47॥

translations.english: Just as the mighty ocean rejoices at sunrise, the inherently cheerful Sumantra became delighted to see the king.

verses.sloka: इन्द्रमस्यां तु वेLआयामभितुष्टाव मातलिः ॥२-१४-४८॥
verses.transliteration: indramasyāṁ tu veLāyāmabhituṣṭāva mātaliḥ ॥2-14-48॥

translations.english: Just as Indra's charioteer at this time (at dawn) extols him, the conquerer of demons, so do I rouse you (with a song).

verses.sloka: सोऽजयद्धानवान्सर्वांस्तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम् ।वेदाः सहाङ्गविद्याश्छ यथाह्यात्मभुवम् विभुम् ॥२-१४-४९॥
verses.transliteration: so'jayaddhānavānsarvāṁstathā tvāṁ bodhayāmyaham ।vedāḥ sahāṅgavidyāścha yathāhyātmabhuvam vibhum ॥2-14-49॥

translations.english: Just as the Vedas and Vedangas awaken the selfborn lord Brahma, so do I awaken you.

verses.sloka: ब्रह्माणम् बोधयन्त्यद्य तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम् ।आदित्यः सह चन्द्रेण यथा भूतधरां शुभाम् ॥२-१४-५०॥
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇam bodhayantyadya tathā tvāṁ bodhayāmyaham ।ādityaḥ saha candreṇa yathā bhūtadharāṁ śubhām ॥2-14-50॥

translations.english: As the Sun along with the Moon awakens the auspicious earth which supports all beings, in the same way I am awakening you today.

verses.sloka: बोधयत्यद्य पृथिवीं तथा त्वाम् बोधयाम्यहम् ।उत्तिष्ठाशु महाराज कृतकौतुकमङ्गLअः ॥२-१४-५१॥
verses.transliteration: bodhayatyadya pṛthivīṁ tathā tvām bodhayāmyaham ।uttiṣṭhāśu mahārāja kṛtakautukamaṅgaLaḥ ॥2-14-51॥

translations.english: O mighty king get up at once like the Sun rising up mount Meru. Put on your beautiful body auspicious robes befitting the festivity.

verses.sloka: विराजमानो वपुषा मेरोरिव दिवाकरः ।सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्थ्स शिववैश्रवणावपि ॥२-१४-५२॥
verses.transliteration: virājamāno vapuṣā meroriva divākaraḥ ।somasūryau ca kākutthsa śivavaiśravaṇāvapi ॥2-14-52॥

translations.english: O descendent of Kakutstha, may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra bestow victory on you.

verses.sloka: वरुणाश्छग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिश्न्तु ते ।गता भगवती रात्रिः कृतकृत्य मिदं तव ॥२-१४-५३॥
verses.transliteration: varuṇāśchagnirindraśca vijayaṁ pradiśntu te ।gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ kṛtakṛtya midaṁ tava ॥2-14-53॥

translations.english: O best among kings the holy night has passed. Having been acquainted with the acts accomplished so far, perform whatever is further necessary for the installation ceremony. All preparations for Rama's coronation ceremony have since been complete.

verses.sloka: बुद्ध्यस्व सृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम् ।उदतिष्ठत रामस्य समग्रमभिषेचन्म् ॥२-१४-५४॥
verses.transliteration: buddhyasva sṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram ।udatiṣṭhata rāmasya samagramabhiṣecanm ॥2-14-54॥

translations.english: O best among kings the holy night has passed. Having been acquainted with the acts accomplished so far, perform whatever is further necessary for the installation ceremony. All preparations for Rama's coronation ceremony have since been complete.

verses.sloka: पौरजानपदैश्चापि नैगमैश्च कृताञ्जलिः ।स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ब्राह्मणैः सह तिष्ठति ॥२-१४-५५॥
verses.transliteration: paurajānapadaiścāpi naigamaiśca kṛtāñjaliḥ ।svayaṁ vasiṣṭho bhagavān brāhmaṇaiḥ saha tiṣṭhati ॥2-14-55॥

translations.english: Venerable Vasistha along with inhabitants of the city and countryside including merchants and brahmins with folded hands awaits you.

verses.sloka: क्षिप्रमाज्ञ्प्यतां राजन् राघवस्याभिषेचन्म् ।यथा ह्यपालाः पशवो यथा सेना ह्यानायका ॥२-१४-५६॥
verses.transliteration: kṣipramājñpyatāṁ rājan rāghavasyābhiṣecanm ।yathā hyapālāḥ paśavo yathā senā hyānāyakā ॥2-14-56॥

translations.english: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

verses.sloka: यथा च्न्द्रं विना रात्रिर्यथा गावो विना वृषम् ।एवं हि भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र राजा न दृश्यते ॥२-१४-५७॥
verses.transliteration: yathā cndraṁ vinā rātriryathā gāvo vinā vṛṣam ।evaṁ hi bhavitā rāṣṭraṁ yatra rājā na dṛśyate ॥2-14-57॥

translations.english: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

verses.sloka: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमिवार्थवत् ।अभ्यकीर्यत शोकेन भूय एव महीपतिः ॥२-१४-५८॥
verses.transliteration: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sāntvapūrvamivārthavat ।abhyakīryata śokena bhūya eva mahīpatiḥ ॥2-14-58॥

translations.english: Hearing these meaningful words of Sumantra uttered in an appealing tone, the lord of the earth relapsed into grief.

verses.sloka: ततः स राजा तम् सूतम् सन्न हर्षः सुतम् प्रति ।शोक आरक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उद्वीक्ष्य उवाच धार्मिकः ॥२-१४-५९॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā tam sūtam sanna harṣaḥ sutam prati ।śoka ārakta īkṣaṇaḥ śrīmān udvīkṣya uvāca dhārmikaḥ ॥2-14-59॥

translations.english: The virtuous and glorious king thinking of his son without cheer looked upward with eyes red with tears and said to the charioteer, You are causing my heart excruciating pain with your words.

verses.sloka: वाक्यैस्तु खलु मर्माणि मम भूयो निकृन्तसि ।सुमन्त्रः करुणम् श्रुत्वा द्Rष्ट्वा दीनम् च पार्थिवम् ॥२-१४-६०॥
verses.transliteration: vākyaistu khalu marmāṇi mama bhūyo nikṛntasi ।sumantraḥ karuṇam śrutvā dRṣṭvā dīnam ca pārthivam ॥2-14-60॥

translations.english: Having heard the sorrowful words of the king and having seen his wretched state Sumantra with palms folded moved away a little from the place.

verses.sloka: प्रग्Rहीत अन्जलिः किम्चित् तस्मात् देशात् अपाक्रमन् ।यदा वक्तुम् स्वयम् दैन्यान् न शशाक मही पतिः ॥२-१४-६१॥
verses.transliteration: pragRhīta anjaliḥ kimcit tasmāt deśāt apākraman ।yadā vaktum svayam dainyān na śaśāka mahī patiḥ ॥2-14-61॥

translations.english: When the king himself in that wretched state was not able to speak to Sumantra, crafty Kaikeyi said to him in reply:

verses.sloka: तदा सुमन्त्रम् मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह ।सुमन्त्र राजा रजनीं रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः ॥२-१४-६२॥
verses.transliteration: tadā sumantram mantrajñā kaikeyī pratyuvāca ha ।sumantra rājā rajanīṁ rāmaharṣasamutsukaḥ ॥2-14-62॥

translations.english: O Sumantra, excited with joy on account of the (proposed) installation of Rama, the king did not have a wink of sleep all night. He is weary and overpowered with sleep.

verses.sloka: प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तो निद्रावशमुपेयुवान् ।तद्गच्छ त्वरितं सूत राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम् ॥२-१४-६३॥
verses.transliteration: prajāgarapariśrānto nidrāvaśamupeyuvān ।tadgaccha tvaritaṁ sūta rājaputraṁ yaśasvinam ॥2-14-63॥

translations.english: So, O Sumantra quickly fetch the gentle, illustrious prince Rama. Let there be no hesitation in this matter.

verses.sloka: राममानय भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।स मन्यमानः कल्याणम् हृदयेन नन्नन्ध च ॥२-१४-६४॥
verses.transliteration: rāmamānaya bhadraṁ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।sa manyamānaḥ kalyāṇam hṛdayena nannandha ca ॥2-14-64॥

translations.english: Thinking that an auspicious event will take place, he rejoiced at heart and in obedience to royal order, left at once.

verses.sloka: निर्जगाम च संप्रीत्या त्वरितो राजशासनात् ।सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास त्वरितं चोदितस्तया ॥२-१४-६५॥
verses.transliteration: nirjagāma ca saṁprītyā tvarito rājaśāsanāt ।sumantraścintayāmāsa tvaritaṁ coditastayā ॥2-14-65॥

translations.english: Urged by Kaikeyi, Sumantra thought 'Righteous Rama will definitely come here for the purpose of installation'.

verses.sloka: व्यक्तं रामोऽभिषेकार्थमिहायास्यति धर्मवित् ।इति सूतो मतिं कृत्वा हर्षेण महता वृतः ॥२-१४-६६॥
verses.transliteration: vyaktaṁ rāmo'bhiṣekārthamihāyāsyati dharmavit ।iti sūto matiṁ kṛtvā harṣeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ ॥2-14-66॥

translations.english: So thought the charioteer and filled with great delight left (the inner apartment), eager to see the mightyarmed Rama.

verses.sloka: निर्जगाम महाबाहो राघवस्य दिदृक्षया ।सागरह्रदसंकाशात्सुमन्त्रोऽन्तःपुराच्छुभात् ॥२-१४-६७॥
verses.transliteration: nirjagāma mahābāho rāghavasya didṛkṣayā ।sāgarahradasaṁkāśātsumantro'ntaḥpurācchubhāt ॥2-14-67॥

translations.english: Sumantra, departed from the auspcious inner apartment which looked like the deep waters of the sea and saw people thronging the gate.

verses.sloka: निष्क्रम्य जनसंबाधं ददर्श द्वारमग्रतः ।ततः पुरस्तत्सासा विनिर्गतो ।महीपतीन् द्वारगतो विलोकयन् ।ददर्श पौरान् विविधान्महाधना ।नुपस्थितान् द्वारमुपेत्य विष्ठतान् ॥२-१४-६८॥
verses.transliteration: niṣkramya janasaṁbādhaṁ dadarśa dvāramagrataḥ ।tataḥ purastatsāsā vinirgato ।mahīpatīn dvāragato vilokayan ।dadarśa paurān vividhānmahādhanā ।nupasthitān dvāramupetya viṣṭhatān ॥2-14-68॥

translations.english: Then Sumantra hastened towards the gate where he saw kings, wealthy people and citizens who had already arrived and waiting there. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
